title: hieracium laeticolor
intro: Hieracium laeticolor, commonly known as False Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, known for its bright yellow flowers. The health benefits of Hieracium laeticolor include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium laeticolor include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
